qa_items.title: Q298（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: Can hBP03-105 〈Lunaito〉 revealed by hBP03-001 〈Himemori Luna〉's SP Oshi Skill 'Lunaito Assemble' be attached to anyone other than 〈Himemori Luna〉?
qa_items.answer: No, it cannot.

qa_items.title: Q297（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: If there are 4 copies of hBP03-105 〈Lunaito〉 in my Archive, can I use hBP03-001 〈Himemori Luna〉's SP Oshi Skill 'Lunaito Assemble'?
qa_items.answer: Yes, you pay the Holo Power, look through your deck, and since there are no hBP03-105 〈Lunaito〉 that can be attached to a Holomem, you resolve the effect and end it. [Updated 4/01] There was an error in the content posted on 3/11 (Tue). We apologize and have made the correction.

qa_items.title: Q296（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: If there are no cards with 'PC' in my deck, can I use hBP03-001 〈Himemori Luna〉's Oshi Skill 'I Know PCs, No Problem!'?
qa_items.answer: Yes, in that case, you pay the Holo Power, look through your deck, and since there are no cards with 'PC' that can be added to your hand, you resolve the effect and end it.

qa_items.question: If there are no hBP03-107 〈35P〉 in my Archive, can I use hBP03-003 〈Sakura Miko〉's Oshi Skill 'Is 35P Coming Back!?'?

qa_items.question: If my Oshi Holomem is hBP03-004 〈FUWAMOCO〉, can I add hBP03-050 〈FUWAMOCO〉 to my hand using hBP03-084 〈Gorgeous PC〉?

qa_items.title: Q303（2025.03.11）

qa_items.title: Q302（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: Can hBP03-004 〈FUWAMOCO〉's Oshi Skill 'Moko-chan!' send Cheer to my own hBP03-050 〈FUWAMOCO〉?

qa_items.title: Q330（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: When I want to use hBP03-066 〈Inugami Korone〉's Gift 'Wonderful~♡' and hBP03-006 〈Inugami Korone〉's SP Oshi Skill 'WOW WOW WOW WOW,' which ability is processed first?
qa_items.answer: Since both abilities can be used 'when downed,' you can process them in any order you prefer.

qa_items.title: Q305（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: My hBP03-066 〈Inugami Korone〉 is stacked as the third card (on top of Debut and 1st Holomem) and gets downed during the opponent's turn. Afterward, I want to use hBP03-006 〈Inugami Korone〉's SP Oshi Skill 'WOW WOW WOW WOW' to return a Holomem to my hand. What does 'the stacked Holomem including the chosen Holomem' refer to in this case?
qa_items.answer: In this case, since hBP03-066 〈Inugami Korone〉 is stacked on top of Debut and 1st Holomem, you return one of the three cards of your choice to your hand.

qa_items.title: Q304（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: If two of my 〈Inugami Korone〉 are downed simultaneously by the opponent's hBP01-087 〈Kobo Kanaeru〉's Arts 'Rain Mantra,' can I use hBP03-006 〈Inugami Korone〉's SP Oshi Skill 'WOW WOW WOW WOW' to reassign Cheer for both and return a Holomem to my hand for both?
qa_items.answer: No. Downing is processed one at a time, so the skill can only be used for one of them.

qa_items.title: Q308（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: Using hBP03-012 〈Himemori Luna〉's Bloom Effect 'Let's Make the Best Live Together,' I chose hBP01-096 〈Usada Pekora〉 with hBP01-123 〈Wild Rabbit Alliance〉 attached. Then, I performed a Collab and used the Collab Effect 'That's an Adventure,' and further rerolled the dice using hBP01-123 〈Wild Rabbit Alliance〉's ability. In this case, does hBP01-096 〈Usada Pekora〉's Arts get '+20' even if hBP01-123 〈Wild Rabbit Alliance〉 is no longer attached when the Arts is used?

qa_items.title: Q312（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: When the opponent's Performance Step begins, after using the Gift 'A Glimpse of a Foreign World' of hBP03-022 〈Aki Rosenthal〉, if hBP03-022 〈Aki Rosenthal〉 is downed by the Arts of the opponent's 〈Fubuki Shirakami〉, and due to the Favorite SP Skill 'Fubukingdom' of hBP02-001 〈Fubuki Shirakami〉, a die is rolled and an odd number comes up, does the effect of hBP03-022 〈Aki Rosenthal〉's Gift 'A Glimpse of a Foreign World'—'Your Life won't be reduced by opponent's abilities'—not activate, resulting in Life being reduced by '-1'?
qa_items.answer: No, the Gift 'A Glimpse of a Foreign World' activates 'when the opponent's Performance Step begins,' so during that turn, even if hBP03-022 〈Aki Rosenthal〉 is no longer on the field, your Life will not be reduced by '-1'.

qa_items.title: Q311（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: Does the effect of hBP03-022 〈Aki Rosenthal〉's Gift 'A Glimpse of a Foreign World'—'Your Life won't be reduced by opponent's abilities'—prevent Life reduction even from Arts damage or Special damage that causes a Down?
qa_items.answer: No, Life reduction due to rules when downed by Arts damage or Special damage will still occur as normal Life damage. The effect only prevents reduction caused by abilities that directly state 'Life -X (value)'.

qa_items.title: Q246（2024.12.12）
qa_items.question: The 〈Bloom Effect〉 'Seductive Gaze' of hBP02-060 〈Yuzuki Choco〉 states 'Deal 10 Special Damage for every 10 Damage healed.' If the target of the damage is 〈Shirogane Noel〉 with hBP02-100 'Shirogane Holy Knights' attached, will the damage become 0 regardless of how much damage was healed, even if 10 damage is dealt multiple times?
qa_items.answer: No, the damage dealt by this ability is applied as a lump sum. For example, if you heal '50' damage, '50' Special Damage is dealt at once. If used against a Holomem with hBP02-100 'Shirogane Holy Knights' attached, and you healed '50', '50' Special Damage would be dealt, but it is reduced by '10', so the final damage dealt would be '40'.

qa_items.answer: 処理の優先順位として、ルールとして処理されるもの（ダウン処理など）が優先的にすべて処理されます。次にターンプレイヤー側で処理すべき能力（使った時に発揮される能力など）が優先的にすべて処理されます。そして最後に、非ターンプレイヤー側で処理すべき能力（ダメージを与えられた時に発揮される能力など）がすべて処理されます。hBP01-116〈うぱお〉は非ターンプレイヤー側で処理すべき能力となるため、すべて最後に処理されます。

qa_items.title: Q211（2024.10.04）
qa_items.question: The opponent rolls the die with their Center Holomem hBP01-023 〈Tokino Sora〉's Arts 'Can't Stop Me!' and gets an odd number, allowing them to use this Arts one more time. If I have hBP01-027 〈Vestia Zeta〉 in my Collab Position, at which timing can I use the Gift 'V.7'?
qa_items.answer: You can choose to use it either when receiving damage from the first use of 'Can't Stop Me!' or the second use. ■If used when receiving damage from the first use: Roll the die with 'V.7' when taking damage from the first use and resolve the subsequent effects. When receiving damage from the second use, since this ability has already been used, the [Once per Turn] condition is not met, and you take the Arts damage as is. ■If used when receiving damage from the second use: Do not roll the die with 'V.7' when taking damage from the first use and take the Arts damage as is. When receiving damage from the second use, roll the die with 'V.7' and resolve the subsequent effects.

qa_items.title: Q56（2024.09.21）
qa_items.question: Regarding the Extra text on hBP01-027 〈Vestia Zeta〉 that states 'When this Holomem is downed, your Life -2', does this mean that in addition to the standard Life -1 when a Holomem is downed, an additional Life -2 is applied, totaling Life -3?

qa_items.title: Q55（2024.09.21）
qa_items.question: If the opponent's ability to deal special damage activates and I choose not to use the Gift 'V.7' of hBP01-027 〈Vestia Zeta〉, can I use the Gift 'V.7' ability if the opponent's ability activates special damage again afterward?

qa_items.question: If my hBP01-034 〈Aki Rosenthal〉 with hBP01-114 〈Stone Axe〉 and hBP01-119 〈Jobs〉 attached and 10 HP remaining uses an Arts, can I deal Arts damage to the opponent's Holomem?

qa_items.title: Q370 (2025.04.28)
qa_items.question: If I use the Art 'Shining Comet' of my hBP01-081 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉 to down the opponent's Center Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached, then perform down processing, and use the SP Oshi Skill 'Shooting Star' of my hBP01-007 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉 to down the opponent's Back Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached, when are the abilities of each hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 processed?
qa_items.answer: Processing priority is as follows: Rule-based processing (such as down processing) is handled first in full. Next, abilities that the turn player must process (such as effects triggered upon use) are handled in full with priority. Finally, abilities that the non-turn player must process (such as effects triggered upon receiving damage) are handled last in full. Since hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 is an ability for the non-turn player to process, it is handled last.

qa_items.title: Q216 (2024.10.23)

qa_items.answer: When the Holomem's HP reaches 0, down processing is performed, and after the down is confirmed, the Oshi Skill 'Wild Rabbits~' is used. After processing the ability and sending Cheers to the Holomem from Life, the SP Oshi Skill 'Shooting Star' can be used.

qa_items.title: Q370（2025.04.28）
qa_items.question: I used the Arts 'Shining Comet' of my hBP01-081 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉 and downed the opponent's Center Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. After processing the down, I used the SP Oshi Skill 'Shooting Star' of my hBP01-007 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉 to down the opponent's Back Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. When are the effects of each hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 processed?
qa_items.answer: Processing priority is as follows: rule-based processes (such as down processing) are resolved first. Next, effects that need to be processed on the turn player's side (such as effects triggered upon use) are resolved in full. Finally, effects that need to be processed on the non-turn player's side (such as effects triggered when damage is taken) are resolved in full. Since hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 is an effect to be processed on the non-turn player's side, it is resolved last.

Switch your opponent's Center Holomem with one of their Back Holomems.

LIMITED: Can only be used once per turn.

qa_items.question: Regarding hBP01-108 〈Then We’re Enemies〉, can I use this card if the opponent’s stage has no Center Holomem or no Back Holomem?

You can only use this card when your Life is lower than your opponent’s.

If the opponent has no Collab Holomem, they must move one of their Back Holomem to the Collab position (this movement is not treated as a Collab).

qa_items.answer: The player who did not use hBP03-088 〈Waiting for Collab〉 chooses.

qa_items.question: If I use hBP03-088 〈Waiting for Collab〉 to move an opponent’s Back Holomem to the Collab Position, does the opponent move that Holomem back to the Back Position during their Reset Step?
qa_items.answer: Yes, they move it back to the Back Position and put it to rest.

qa_items.question: If I use hBP03-088 〈Waiting for Collab〉 to move an opponent’s Back Holomem to the Collab Position, does the 'When Collaborated' ability activate?
qa_items.answer: No, it does not.

qa_items.title: Q348（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: If the opponent has no Holomem in the Back Position and the Collab Position is empty, can I use hBP03-088 〈Waiting for Collab〉?
qa_items.answer: No, you cannot use it. If resolving the card results in no change to the game state other than placing the Support card in the Archive, the Support card cannot be played.

qa_items.title: Q347（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: When using hBP03-088 〈Waiting for Collab〉, can I move an opponent’s resting Holomem to the Collab Position?
qa_items.answer: Yes, you can.

qa_items.question: I used the Arts 'Shining Comet' of my hBP01-081 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉 to down the opponent's Center Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. In this case, when are the abilities of each hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 processed?
qa_items.answer: Processing priority is as follows: Rule-based actions (such as down processing) are processed first in full. Next, abilities on the turn player's side that need to be processed (such as abilities activated upon use) are processed in full. Finally, abilities on the non-turn player's side that need to be processed (such as abilities activated upon taking damage) are processed in full. Since hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 is an ability on the non-turn player's side, it is processed last.

qa_items.title: Q370（2025.04.28）
qa_items.question: I used the Arts 'Shining Comet' of my hBP01-081 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉 to down the opponent's Center Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. After processing the down, I used the SP Oshi Skill 'Shooting Star' of my hBP01-007 〈Hoshimachi Suisei〉 to down the opponent's Back Holomem 〈Amane Kanata〉 with hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 attached. In this case, when are the abilities of each hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 processed?
qa_items.answer: Processing priority is as follows: Rule-based actions (such as down processing) are processed first in full. Next, abilities on the turn player's side that need to be processed (such as abilities activated upon use) are processed in full. Finally, abilities on the non-turn player's side that need to be processed (such as abilities activated upon taking damage) are processed in full. Since hBP01-116 〈Upao〉 is an ability on the non-turn player's side, it is processed last.

qa_items.title: Q370（2025.04.28）
qa_items.question: 自分のhBP01-081〈星街すいせい〉のアーツ「輝く彗星」を使い、hBP01-116〈うぱお〉が付いているセンターホロメンの〈天音かなた〉をダウンさせました。その後ダウン処理を行い、自分のhBP01-007〈星街すいせい〉のSP推しスキル「シューティングスター」を使い、相手のバックホロメンのhBP01-116〈うぱお〉が付いているバックホロメンの〈天音かなた〉をダウンさせました。この場合、それぞれのhBP01-116〈うぱお〉の能力はいつ処理されますか？
qa_items.answer: 処理の優先順位として、ルールとして処理されるもの（ダウン処理など）が優先的にすべて処理されます。次にターンプレイヤー側で処理すべき能力（使った時に発揮される能力など）が優先的にすべて処理されます。そして最後に、非ターンプレイヤー側で処理すべき能力（ダメージを与えられた時に発揮される能力など）がすべて処理されます。hBP01-116〈うぱお〉は非ターンプレイヤー側で処理すべき能力となるため、すべて最後に処理されます。

qa_items.question: hBP01-081〈星街すいせい〉のアーツ「輝く彗星」により、推しホロメンがhBP01-004〈兎田ぺこら〉である相手のセンターホロメンのHPを0にしました。その後、自分のSP推しスキル「シューティングスター」と相手の推しスキル「野兎たち～」をそれぞれが使いたい場合、どちらから先に処理しますか。
qa_items.answer: ホロメンのHPが0になった時点でダウン処理をし、ダウンが確定してから推しスキル「野兎たち～」を使用します。能力の処理後、ライフからホロメンにエールを送った後にSP推しスキル「シューティングスター」を使用することができます。

qa_items.question: hBP01-081〈星街すいせい〉のアーツ「輝く彗星」により、相手のセンターホロメンのHPを0にしました。その後、SP推しスキル「シューティングスター」を使う場合、相手がライフからエールを送るのとSP推しスキル「シューティングスター」はどちらから処理しますか。
qa_items.answer: ホロメンのHPが0になった時点でダウン処理をするため、先にライフからホロメンにエールを送り、その後、SP推しスキル「シューティングスター」を使用することができます。

qa_items.title: Q205（2024.10.04）
qa_items.question: hBP01-081〈星街すいせい〉のアーツ「輝く彗星」のテキスト「このホロメンの青エール２枚をアーカイブできる：」について、青エール2枚をアーカイブしなかった場合にも（このアーツは相手のバックホロメンも対象にできる）は適用されますか？
qa_items.answer: いいえ、バックホロメンをアーツの対象にすることはできません。テキストのコストを解決しなかった場合、その後のテキストの効果は解決されず、アーツダメージの対象にできるのはセンターホロメンかコラボホロメンのどちらかになります。

qa_items.title: Q91（2024.09.21）
qa_items.question: 自分のhBP01-081〈星街すいせい〉が3枚目に重なっている状態（Debut、1stホロメンホロメンの上にhBP01-081〈星街すいせい〉が重ねられている状態）でアーツ「輝く彗星」を使用し、青のエール2枚をアーカイブにしました。この場合、このアーツで相手のホロメンに与えられるダメージは、180ダメージですか、それとも240ダメージのどちらになりますか？
qa_items.answer: 180ダメージになります。Debutホロメンの上に1stホロメンホロメン、hBP01-081〈星街すいせい〉の合計2枚のカードが重なっている状態のため、アーツダメージ60に＋120が加算されます。

You cannot use this card unless there are at least 2 Holomem of different single colors on your stage.

Choose 2 Holomem of different single colors on your stage. Reveal one 1st Holomem of the same color as each chosen Holomem (excluding Buzz) from your deck and add them to your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

LIMITED: Can only be used once per turn.

qa_items.title: Q404 (2025.06.11)
qa_items.question: When using hBP04-089 'Two-Tone Color PC' and choosing 'Tokino Sora' and 'Fuwawa Abyssguard' as Holomem of different single colors on my stage, can I add 'SorAZ' and 'FUWAMOCO' to my hand as 1st Holomem of the same colors as the chosen Holomem?
qa_items.answer: Yes, you can add them.

qa_items.title: Q403 (2025.06.11)
qa_items.question: When using hBP04-089 'Two-Tone Color PC', can I choose a Spot Holomem as one of the Holomem of different single colors on my stage?
qa_items.answer: No, you cannot. Spot Holomem are treated as colorless Holomem, and colorless does not count as a color.

qa_items.title: Q402 (2025.06.11)
qa_items.question: What does 'Holomem of different single colors' mean for hBP04-089 'Two-Tone Color PC'?
qa_items.answer: It refers to Holomem who each have only one color, and there must be 2 or more of them. For example, hBP01-021 'Tokino Sora' has only one color, while hSD01-013 'SorAZ' has two colors.

[hBP01-021 : Tokino Sora]

1060.name: Work PC
1060.abilityText:
You cannot use this card unless you have 6 or fewer cards in your hand, excluding this card.

Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Reveal 1 Holomem and 1 [Tool, Mascot, or Fan] card from among them, and add the revealed cards to your hand. Then, return the remaining cards to the bottom of your deck in any order.

LIMITED: Can only be used once per turn.

1061.name: Limit Meal
1061.abilityText: For this turn, reduce the ◇ cost of one Arts of your 'Ichijou Ririka' by 1. You can only use 'Limit Meal' once per turn.

Wanna Fight?' of hBP04-037 'Ichijou Ririka' on an opponent's Collab Holomem. In this case, can I deal 30 damage to the Collab Holomem without dealing 50 damage to the Center Holomem?
qa_items.answer: Yes, you can deal the damage.

qa_items.title: Q373 (2025.06.11)

qa_items.title: Q398（2025.06.11）
qa_items.question: Can hBP04-072 〈Oozora Subaru〉's Art 'Sun Girl' count hBP01-126 〈Audience〉 or hBP03-107 〈35P〉?

qa_items.title: Q323（2025.03.11）
qa_items.question: When using hBP03-045 〈Kobo Kanaeru〉's Bloom Effect 'Blue Rain' to deal '10' and '20' damage to two of the opponent's 〈Omaru Polka〉 with hBP01-126 〈Audience〉 attached, will the damage dealt become '20' and '30' respectively?

qa_items.title: Q206（2024.10.04）
qa_items.question: If my Holomem with hBP01-114 〈Stone Axe〉 and hBP01-126 〈Audience〉 attached uses an Art, does the ability of hBP01-126 〈Audience〉 'The Holomem this Fan is attached to takes +10 Damage' apply when taking 10 Special Damage from hBP01-114 〈Stone Axe〉's ability?
qa_items.answer: Yes, it applies, resulting in a total of 20 Damage taken.

qa_items.title: Q114（2024.09.21）
qa_items.question: Is hBP01-126 〈Audience〉 always treated as a Cheer when attached to a Holomem?
qa_items.answer: No, this card is treated as a Cheer only when checking the conditions for using an Art. At other times, it is treated as a Support Card attached to a Holomem.
